run_ppo_training: run the PPO reinforcement learning training loop with action and critic agents using Hydra config
run_ppo_with_config: run PPO training by calling run_ppo with an action agent, critic agent, logger, and config object
index_3d_tensor: index a 3D tensor using a 2D tensor with the _index helper function
transfer_state_dict: transfer an agent state dict to a specified device using the _state_dict helper function
run_main_entry: run the main entry point that instantiates agents and starts PPO training via Hydra configuration
